## System and Window Information

- **Operating System**: Linux (based on desktop environment and application icons)
- **Window Title**: "Untitled 1.docx - LibreOffice Writer"
- **Date and Time Display**: "Oct 23 17:00" in the top bar
- **Application Name**: LibreOffice Writer
- **Document Status**: Untitled document, 0 words, 0 characters
- **Page Information**: Page 1 of 1
- **Language Setting**: English (Hong Kong)
- **Zoom Level**: 100%
- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right corner

## Desktop Environment and Application Dock

- **Left Dock (Application Launcher)**:
  - Activities button (grid icon) at bottom
  - Chrome browser icon
  - Thunderbird email client icon
  - Visual Studio Code icon
  - VLC media player icon
  - LibreOffice Writer icon (currently active)
  - LibreOffice Calc icon
  - LibreOffice Impress icon
  - GIMP image editor icon
  - File manager icon
  - Software Center icon
  - Help icon (question mark)
  - Trash icon

## Top Menu Bar

- **Menu Options**:
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

## Toolbar and Formatting Ribbon

- **Quick Access Toolbar**:
  - New document
  - Open document
  - Save document
  - Save as
  - Print
  - Find
  - Spelling and grammar check
  - Undo and Redo

- **Formatting Toolbar**:
  - Paragraph style dropdown: "Default Paragraph Style"
  - Font selection: "Liberation Serif"
  - Font size: "12 pt"
  - Bold (B)
  - Italic (I)
  - Underline (U)
  - Strikethrough (S)
  - Superscript (A°)
  - Subscript (A_)
  - Font color (A with color dropdown)
  - Highlight color (A with highlight dropdown)
  - Text alignment options (left, center, right, justify)
  - List formatting (bulleted, numbered)
  - Indentation controls
  - Text direction (L to R, R to L)
  - Special characters (Ω)

## Document Area

- **Document Content**: Blank white page with default margins
- **Page Layout**: Single page, no content entered
- **Page Margins**: Standard margins visible
- **Page Numbering**: Page 1 of 1
- **Document Statistics**: 0 words, 0 characters

## Status Bar

- **Left Side**:
  - Page number: "Page 1 of 1"
  - Word count: "0 words, 0 characters"
- **Center**:
  - Page style: "Default Page Style"
- **Right Side**:
  - Language: "English (Hong Kong)"
  - Zoom control: "100%"
  - View mode indicators

## Sidebar (Right Panel)

- **Vertical Scrollbar**: Visible on the right side
- **Sidebar Icons**:
  - Document properties (orange icon with document)
  - Font settings (purple icon with "A")
  - Page layout (blue icon with page)
  - Styles (white icon with document)
  - Drawing tools (black icon with pen)

## Notification Bar

- **Blue Notification Banner**:
  - Message 1: "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
  - Message 2: "Your donations support our worldwide community."
  - Buttons: "Get involved" and "Donate"
  - Close button (X) for notification banner

## Document View and Navigation

- **Ruler**: Horizontal ruler with measurement markings (1 to 18)
- **Cursor Position**: Text cursor (I-beam) visible in the document area
- **Page View**: Full-page view with no content
- **Navigation**: No visible navigation pane or thumbnails

## Additional UI Elements

- **Window Controls**: Minimize, Maximize, Close buttons in top-right corner
- **System Tray**: System icons (sound, notifications) in top-right corner
- **Application Icon**: LibreOffice Writer icon in top-left corner
- **Document Title Bar**: "Untitled 1.docx - LibreOffice Writer" in the title bar

## Document Properties and Settings

- **Default Page Style**: "Default Page Style" in status bar
- **Language**: "English (Hong Kong)" in status bar
- **Font**: "Liberation Serif" in formatting toolbar
- **Font Size**: "12 pt" in formatting toolbar
- **Paragraph Style**: "Default Paragraph Style" in formatting toolbar
